description: Talking-head / UGC-in-action wizard for a SAC campaign: generate scripts, strategies, and per-character plans; preview voices; tag scripts; persist wizard state. Read adgpt://pipeline/characters and adgpt://pipeline/voices first. In-action and commercial videos need a Pro plan or higher. Actions: generatePipelineScripts, generateStrategies, generatePlan, plans, getWizardState, saveWizardState, tagScript, voicePreview, voicePreviewStatus. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
name: adgpt_in_action
title: UGC in-action pipeline
